text: Found it — the draftReply config sets stopSequences to a newline character, which would cause generation to halt after the first line, matching the bug report exactly. I want to check if similar stopSequences configs exist elsewhere in ai.ts or agents.ts, since the finish reason would just show 'stop' and look normal rather than erroring out.
The likely culprit is `config: { stopSequences: ['\n'] }` in `draftReply` (line 64). I'll check for other stop sequences and the prompt file before editing.

I don't have an API key to actually run this, but I can reason through it: Gemini's API returns finishReason STOP when a stop sequence is hit, and this is the only stopSequences config in the codebase matching '\n'. That lines up perfectly with the symptom — a reply like "Dear customer,\n\n" would get truncated right after the greeting's newline. This confirms the cause, so I'll proceed with the edit.

text: The root cause was a newline stop sequence in `draftReply`. I removed `config: { stopSequences: ['\n'] }` from the `ai.generate` call in `src/flows.ts`, so the model no longer halts at the first line break. The project type-checks cleanly with `tsc --noEmit`, and I wrote `answer.json` in the project root. I did not run the model live, so the fix is confirmed by code inspection only.
